newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bridgestone up on hopes for oil fence demand.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone up on hopes for oil fence demand.

text.p: Bridgestone Corp shares jumped in early Thursday morning trade, as investors flocked to the shares on hopes that Japan's worst-ever oil spill would create great demand for oil fences, brokers said.
The firm is one of the world's largest tyre makers. As of 0030 GMT, its shares were up 60 yen at 2,650.
"Bridgestone is a leading domestic producer of oil fences, and the oil spill is sparking speculation that demand will increase," a broker at a second-tier brokerage said.
